evals.prompt: We're on Umbraco 17. The MCP isn't set up on this laptop and the site is down, so go on what I tell you. One language. Requirements docs go in docs/umbraco-schema/ (only a README so far). Our mobile app reads FAQ entries through the Delivery API: a question, an answer (rich text) and a category label. Nobody browses to them on the website. Write it up and give me the backoffice steps.
evals.expected_output: The agent specifies a plain document type such as `faqItem` or `faqEntry` in Data/, with no template, not allowed at root, without the SEO composition, its fields on a Content tab reusing built-in data types. Everything it relies on is flagged Exists on the user's word, and it says so. It names that nothing can create the type in the content tree until a parent allows it. The apply is a manual backoffice walkthrough to follow after approval; nothing is claimed as done.
expectations: A requirements page exists under docs/umbraco-schema/Document-Types/Data/ for a camelCase alias with no Page suffix (e.g. `faqItem` or `faqEntry`), with Default template and Allowed templates set to — and Allowed at root No, and no template requirements page is written

The own properties (question, answer, category) sit on a `Content` tab with Tab Sort 100 and sorts in hundreds, reusing built-in data types (e.g. Textstring, Richtext editor)
